newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai rice sale to Manila priced at $300 per tonne.
newsitem.headline: Thai rice sale to Manila priced at $300 per tonne.

text.p: Thailand's 205,000 tonnes of rice sold to Manila under a recent deal was priced at $300 per tonne, a source in the Thai Rice Exporters Association told Reuters on Saturday.
The first batch of 55,000 tonnes will be delivered between March and April and the remaining 150,000 tonnes will be shipped in May and June, the source said, adding that all will be 25 percent grade.
Although the deal was signed recently as a government-to-government deal, the Thai government will for the first time allow private exporters to fulfil it.
In the past, the commerce ministry bought rice from private suppliers to meet government-to-government obligations and shouldered losses if the local rice price surged above the agreed sale price.
The amount will be allocated among Thai Rice Exporters Association members based on their last year's performance and stocks, the source said.
